1.explanation:
• TimePicker/TimePicker.mdx: The primary documentation for the TimePicker component, showing its props, default sizing, and usage. We’ll extend this to document the new size variants.  
• TimePickerSelect/TimePickerSelect.mdx: The AM and Timezone dropdowns are implemented via this specialized Select wrapper. We need to confirm how its sizing is controlled.  
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx: The hh:mm input is a styled TextInput. Reviewing its sizing API and CSS variables is necessary to apply matching 32px and 48px heights.  
• Select/Select.mdx: The underlying Select component defines dropdown heights, paddings, and font sizes. Ensuring consistent styling for the small and large variants requires understanding its size theming.
1.bug_scenario: The bug request is to add two new height variants (32px and 48px) alongside the existing default 40px TimePicker. The provided screenshot shows three horizontal groupings labeled “Choose a time” with heights of 32px, 40px, and 48px. Each grouping consists of a time input field (hh:mm) followed by two dropdown selects (“AM” and “Timezone”). To implement and test these size variants, we need to update the TimePicker container, the text input styling, and the Select-based dropdowns used inside the TimePicker.
